info.title: API.SH: Immobiliare.it
info.description: The Immobiliare.it API from API.SH: public Immobiliare.it data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The real estate agencies of a town on Immobiliare.it: id, name, address, phone numbers, number of listings (for sale and rent), quality index, badge, association, years on the site, featured flag, location, logo, description and profile link (for /immobiliare/v1/agency). 25 per page with the total.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immobiliare-agencies

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A town as in immobiliare.it links, e.g. milano, roma, torino.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Immobiliare.it property listing: title, status, contract, typology, category, price, price per m², rooms and room breakdown, bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, surface and its breakdown by floor, floor, elevator, garage, building year, condition, heating, availability, energy class, features, costs, rent terms, description (translated and the original Italian), reference, created and updated dates, address and coordinates, photos, floor plans, videos, virtual tours, the units of a project, and the agency (phones, logo, opening hours) with its agent. A private seller's name and phone are left out. `raw` holds the site's full record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immobiliare-listing

get.description:
Average asking prices per square metre for sale and for rent in an Italian region, province, town or zone, as Immobiliare.it publishes them: the latest month, the price with its range and yearly change, and the zones or towns below it with their own sale and rent prices and changes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immobiliare-market-prices

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The place part of an immobiliare.it/mercato-immobiliare/ link: region, region/town or region/town/zone, e.g. lombardia/milano or lombardia/milano/centro.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An immobiliare.it/mercato-immobiliare/... link, instead of location.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Immobiliare.it's place suggestions for a partial name: towns, provinces and regions (and zones with zones=true), each with its id, type and parent places.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immobiliare-places

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes for sale or rent in an Italian town, 25 per page, with price, type, rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, floor, condition, features, description, address, coordinates, photos and the agency. Filter by category (houses by default, or rooms, new builds, whole buildings, offices), home type (apartment, villa), elevator, furnished, virtual tour and no auctions. `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immobiliare-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Home type(s) with category houses, comma-separated: apartment, penthouse, detached_house, country_house, villa, terraced_house, loft, other.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition: new (new or under construction), good, to_renovate or excellent (renovated).

parameters.name: private_only
parameters.description: true for listings from private sellers only (no agencies).

parameters.name: cellar
parameters.description: true for homes with a cellar only.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: true for homes with a pool only.

parameters.name: elevator
parameters.description: true for homes with an elevator only.

parameters.name: virtual_tour
parameters.description: true for listings with a virtual tour only.

parameters.name: no_auctions
parameters.description: true to leave out auction listings.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
